_comment: Single source of truth for the addon load order and the foundation file set.
Consumed by tools/autogen/Common.ps1 (.toc + README generation), tools/depcheck.mjs
(the EXEMPT foundation set), tools/gen_schema.lua (the headless framework load) and
Test/support.lua (the spec rig's framework load). Paths use FORWARD slashes; consumers
convert as needed. Keep this file strictly arrays/objects of plain strings with no
colons or brackets inside the strings -- the Lua consumers parse it by syntactic
translation, not a full JSON library.
Core/Init.lua's runtime fail-fast list is the one intentional duplicate (the game
client cannot read repo files); keep it in step when a new manager joins the head.
